user.title: Create a channel controller
user.description: Select the physical light, then add output subentries from this integration's page. This integration owns the whole source: unused RGB channels are switched off on every command. RGB transport also accepts HS/XY sources, but color conversion may mix channels; test the wiring before relying on isolation. Select CCT for a fixed-temperature dimmer. Do not select a group, mask, or transformed light.

error.invalid_source: Select a physical light, not a group, mask, or transformed output.
error.source_unavailable: The source must be available during setup.
error.unsupported_source: The source does not advertise the selected transport.
error.already_configured: This source already has a Light Transform controller.

abort.already_configured: This source already has a Light Transform controller.

user.title: Add output on {transport}
user.description: For an RGB dimmer, select one or more channels (driven equally). For CCT, choose different warm/cold channels and their physical strip temperatures; dimmer channels are ignored. Constant sum limits the combined drive to the requested brightness. Constant max can double combined drive at the midpoint; use only with adequate controller, strip and power-supply ratings. A CCT source supports one fixed-temperature dimmer.

reconfigure.title: Edit output on {transport}
reconfigure.description: Changes preserve the entity identity and do not send a command. Switch the source off before changing wiring or channel assignments. Only fields for the selected output capability are used.
